title: 06. Round and Round with Concrete
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Round and round! A big drum spins on the back of a rumbling truck. Hori's eyes grow round. Wow! Why does that drum keep turning? Round and round, rumble, rumble! Here comes the concrete mixer!
Dad, what's inside that drum? Why does it keep turning? Hori asks excitedly. Dad smiles. That's a concrete mixer truck. Shall we visit the building site where it works? Kongi can come, too!
At the busy building site, a big mixer truck stands with its drum turning. Hello! Have you come to learn about concrete mixers? A driver in a yellow hard hat waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!
That big drum is the mixing drum. It turns to keep mixing what's inside, explains the driver. Concrete will eventually harden, so we keep the load turning and well mixed as we drive. Hori nods.

The driver opens a hatch to show them. Inside, a thick gray mixture sloshes around. This is concrete, made by mixing cement, sand, gravel, and water. Kongi's eyes sparkle. Wow! It looks like acorn porridge! Everyone laughs.
How do you pour the concrete out? Hori asks. The driver unfolds a long channel at the back of the truck. This is the chute. Concrete slides down it. It slopes like a slide. That looks fun!

Would Hori like to help let the concrete out? The driver holds the control lever together with him. Hori pushes it the other way, and the drum begins to turn in reverse! Changing the direction pushes the mixed concrete out. How amazing!

The gray concrete flows down the chute and spreads into a form on the ground. Hori jumps with excitement. Wow! I poured it! His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. Round and round, rumble, rumble! Here comes the concrete mixer!

What happens when this concrete sets? Hori asks. With time, it becomes hard like stone and makes a strong floor. The driver taps a smooth floor poured the day before. Wow! It's really hard! Hori bounces on it, too.

On the way home, Hori holds Dad's hand and chats. The drum turns to mix concrete, the chute pours it out, and it sets into a hard floor! The workers help build strong houses. Hori smiles at the sky. Round and round, rumble, rumble! Here comes the concrete mixer!
